psychological_meaning: Van Cleef evokes feelings of groundedness, sophistication, and understated luxury. Its deep, earthy tone suggests stability and reliability, while its subtle richness hints at hidden depths and refined taste. This color inspires confidence and a sense of timeless elegance.
